description: This file defines a module that provides API functions to perform various TR-369 (User Services Platform) operations such as get, set, add, delete, operate, and fetch information about data models and instances on devices. It includes mock mode support for testing and communicates with a backend API via HTTP POST requests.

methods.name: tr369Get({ deviceId, paths })
methods.description: Performs a TR-369 GET operation to retrieve parameter values from a device.

methods.name: tr369Set({ deviceId, parameters })
methods.description: Performs a TR-369 SET operation to assign values to parameters on a device.

methods.name: tr369Add({ deviceId, path, parameters })
methods.description: Performs a TR-369 ADD operation to create a new object instance on a device.

methods.name: tr369Delete({ deviceId, paths })
methods.description: Performs a TR-369 DELETE operation to remove object instances from a device.

methods.name: tr369Operate({ deviceId, command, commandKey, inputArgs = {} })
methods.description: Performs a TR-369 OPERATE operation to execute commands on a device.

methods.name: tr369GetSupportedDM({ deviceId, paths, firstLevelOnly = false })
methods.description: Retrieves supported data model information from a device.

methods.name: tr369GetInstances({ deviceId, path, firstLevelOnly = false })
methods.description: Retrieves instances of multi-instance objects from a device.
